content.text: Witness the breathtaking beauty of Meghalaya with this 3-Day Meghalaya tour package with Dawki. Explore the best of Shillong and Cherrapunji, and enjoy the crystal-clear river boating, serene waterfalls, caves, living root bridges and spanning green landscapes. This tour package allows visitors to dive into the charm of Meghalaya.

main.title: Tour Highlights
items: Explore the wonderful Shillong with Umiam Lake.
Witness the best attractions of the capital city like Ward’s Lake, Cathedral Church, Lady Hydari Park, Elephant Falls, and Police Bazar.
Visit the Mawlynnong Village and the Living Root Bridge.
Visit Dawki and witness the crystal-clear Dawki river.
Engage in Cherrapunji sightseeing and explore the famous waterfalls, caves and spots.

main.title: Meghalaya Tour Package with Dawki Itinerary

days.title: Day 1 : Guwahati Arrival and Shillong Excursion
items: Upon your arrival in Guwahati, you'll be welcomed by our representative.
From there, proceed on a scenic drive towards Shillong. On the way, enjoy the mesmerizing beauty of Umiam Lake and its splendid surroundings.

After reaching Shillong, engage in witnessing some of the city’s popular attractions including the peaceful Ward’s Lake, the majestic Cathedral Church, well maintained Lady Hydari Park, three-tiered Elephant Falls, and the lively Police Bazar.
After the sightseeing tour, check-in to your hotel and unwind.
The evening is at leisure.

days.title: Day 2 : Engage in Dawki - Mawlynnong Excursion
items: Start your day with a refreshing morning and enjoy your breakfast before checking out from the hotel.
Proceed towards Mawlynnong, well-known for its scenic beauty and exceptional cleanliness.
Discover the charming Mawlynnong Village, famously recognised as the ‘Cleanest Village in Asia’ by Discover India in 2003. You can also visit the famous Living Root Bridge.
After exploring these wonderful attractions, continue your journey towards Dawki.
Upon arrival, you can engage in relaxing boat ride and even indulge in exciting water sports in the crystal-clear waters of the Dawki River.
Later, drive to Cherrapunji for an overnight stay. After reaching, check-in to your stay and unwind for the rest of the day.

days.title: Day 3 : Cherrapunji Sightseeing and Departure
items: Wake up to a lovely morning and enjoy a delicious breakfast.
Later, check-out of your hotel and engage in Cherrapunji excursion.
Visit Mawkdok Dympep Valley, Nohkalikai Falls, Mawsmai Cave and Eco Park.
If time permits, also visit Seven Sisters Falls before proceeding to Guwahati Airport/Railway Station, marking an end to your amazing Meghalaya tour.

items.text: Travellers visiting Meghalaya are required to register on Meghalaya Tourism App and generate an e-invite.
You can download the Meghalaya Tourism App from Google Play Store or App Store.
No reimbursement will be made against missed services.
Travellers are required to show their valid identity cards at the time of check-in to the hotel.
You should not consume alcohol or other intoxicants during your tour.
The vehicle allotted for the tour will be available as per the itinerary and not for general disposal.
In the Northeast, generally, vehicles like Sedan do not have carriers. You are advised to carry one bag per person. Kindly give us prior information in case you have more luggage.

Delay in arrival due to many reasons including flight reschedules shall have to inform to us at an earliest and in case of any sightseeing spot missed due to any delay including spending more time in one sightseeing spot, will not be refundable.

Kajaawa will provide accommodation as per the hotels in the list and in case the listed hotels cannot be provided for any reason like unavailability, scheduled or general maintenance, accident at the hotel, risky road conditions due to bad weather or political disturbance, similar hotels will be provided and you will be informed about the changes in advance.

In Deluxe and Premium Tour Packages, we will generally arrange Deluxe and Premium Hotels but in interior places, we will arrange Homestays, Guest Houses or Standard Hotels as Deluxe and Premium accommodations may not be available in the interiors for any reason.
In case of any unforeseen situations which are beyond our control including bad weather conditions, political disturbance etc., we may change your itinerary or dates of travel.
Travellers may have to bear additional expenses in case of natural calamity including situations like changes in the hotel, changes in tour date etc.
You have to pay 50% of the total tour cost at the time of booking.
After paying 50% you will receive an invoice of your payment and also booking confirmation details containing your detailed travel itinerary and hotel information.
25% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 30 days before the tour starts.
50% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 15-30 days before the tour starts.
100% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 0-15 days before the tour starts.
100% of the tour cost has to be paid 1 (one) week before the tour starts.
Refunds will be processed within 7(seven) business days in the customer’s bank account.
